recognize_zh: 低倍下幾個骨髓顆粒中可見十顆左右深紫色的大型巨核細胞，分布在顆粒內與邊緣，數量明顯超出正常，提示巨核細胞增生。
features: Low-power view of several marrow particles with abundant interspersed fat
Numerous large megakaryocytes (roughly 8–10 in the field) within and along the particles
Megakaryocytes appear as large dark purple cells; lobation and size detail limited at this power
Moderately cellular particles with background hematopoietic cells
Peripheral blood red cells streaming between particles
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows several moderately cellular particles containing abundant fat. Megakaryocytes are increased, with many large cells distributed within and at the edges of the particles. Megakaryocyte nuclear morphology and dysplasia cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic hyperplasia; higher-power evaluation and clinical correlation (platelet count, ITP, reactive thrombocytosis, MPN) are needed.

ddx.vs: Increased megakaryocytes with thrombocytopenia and peripheral destruction, separated from other causes by clinical and CBC correlation rather than by this low-power view.
Shows large hyperlobulated or atypical hyperchromatic megakaryocytes in tight clusters on biopsy, with driver mutations (JAK2/CALR/MPL).
Megakaryocytes are small hypolobated or micromegakaryocytes with separated nuclear lobes on high power, often with dysplasia in other lineages.
